#summary Video Tutorial on how to run the EMFStore as a developer.

 <wiki:video url="http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TOwy7hKKbq4"/>

This tutorial explains how to run the EMFStore for UNICASE as a developer. The version used is 0.5.2 which uses EMFStore in version 0.9.3.

In order to follow this tutorial, you need to check out the UNICASE plug-ins and install EMFStore.

See:<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/Getting_started_as_developer Getting started as UNICASE developer]<br />
[http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/CheckoutTutorial Checkout UNICASE code from SVN]
